hooks.name: Changelog Entry Guard
hooks.description: At `git commit`, asks if the edit journal has a behavioural source change (a non-test .rs under a crate's src/) but CHANGELOG.md is not among the session's edits. Mirrors commit-review-gate: `ask`, not block, because an internal refactor legitimately needs no entry and a guard cannot tell one from a behaviour change. Scope is the agent's own writes (target/.kiro-session-edits), never the dirty tree. Fails open. Logic: bin/changelog-entry-guard.sh.
